summary: 表示过去某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作：was / were + 动词-ing。

rules.title: 结构：was / were + 动词-ing
rules.detail: 第一人称单数和第三人称单数用 was；其余用 were。常与 at that time、at 8:00 yesterday、this morning 等表示过去具体时刻的时间连用。

examples.en: I was doing my homework at 8:00 last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚八点我正在做作业。

examples.en: They were having dinner when I arrived.
examples.zh: 我到达时他们正在吃晚饭。

rules.title: when / while 引导的时间状语
rules.detail: while + 过去进行时（延续动作作背景），when + 一般过去时（短暂动作）。句式：while sb was doing..., ... did sth。

examples.en: While I was walking in the street, I met an old friend.
examples.zh: 我正在街上走时，遇到了一位老朋友。

examples.en: When the phone rang, she was cooking.
examples.zh: 电话响的时候，她正在做饭。

pitfalls: was/were 混用：❌ We was playing chess. → ✓ We were playing chess.
漏掉-ing：❌ I was read a book at nine. → ✓ I was reading a book at nine.
while 后用短暂动词：❌ While I got there, he was sleeping. → ✓ When I got there, he was sleeping.

questions.stem: This time yesterday Jack ___ a bike in the yard.
questions.explain: this time yesterday（昨天这个时候）是过去进行时标志；Jack 单数用 was repairing。

questions.stem: ___ I was cooking, the phone rang.
questions.explain: while + 过去进行时（延续动作作背景），从句用进行时首选 while。

questions.stem: — I called you at 9:00 last night, but nobody answered. — Sorry, I ___ a shower.
questions.explain: 昨晚 9 点那一刻「正在洗澡」，用过去进行时 was taking。

questions.stem: What ___ you ___ at this time yesterday?
questions.explain: this time yesterday 提示过去进行时：were you doing。

questions.stem: They ___ (clean) the classroom at 5:00 yesterday afternoon.
questions.explain: 过去某时刻正在进行的动作，they 用 were cleaning。

questions.stem: He ___ (not sleep) when his mother came back.
questions.explain: he 用 was；否定 was not sleeping。

questions.stem: While we was having lunch, someone knocked at the door.
questions.explain: we 是复数，过去进行时用 were having。

questions.stem: 昨天下午四点，爷爷正在浇花。（翻译整句）
answer: grandpa was watering the flowers at four yesterday afternoon.
grandfather was watering the flowers at four yesterday afternoon.
questions.explain: 过去某时刻正在发生：was watering；grandpa 单数用 was。

questions.stem: 当她进来的时候，我们正在讨论这个问题。（翻译整句）
answer: we were discussing the problem when she came in.
we were talking about the problem when she came in.
questions.explain: 主句过去进行时（我们正在讨论），when 从句用一般过去时（came in）。
